# ResumeCraft — Free ATS Resume Builder
# https://resume.devbench.co.in

## About
ResumeCraft is a free, browser-based resume builder. Users can create, customize, and
download professional, ATS-optimized resumes as PDFs — no account or payment required.

## Key Features
- 14 professionally designed resume templates (Classic, Modern, Executive, Ivy League, etc.)
- Real-time ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compatibility scoring
- AI-powered writing assistance: summaries, bullet point enhancement, keyword matching
- One-click PDF export
- All data stored locally in the browser; no personal data is transmitted or stored by us

## Pages & Content
- / — Landing page with product overview, features, steps, and FAQ
- /templates — Gallery of all 14 resume templates with descriptions and previews
- /examples — Role-specific resume examples (Software Engineer, Product Manager, etc.)
- /builder — Interactive resume editor (client-side, no crawlable dynamic content)
- /builder/new — Template selection screen
- /privacy — Privacy Policy
- /terms — Terms of Service

## Content Usage for LLMs
Public marketing copy, template descriptions, feature descriptions, and FAQ answers on
this site may be referenced for educational and informational purposes.

User-generated resume content is stored exclusively in the user's browser (localStorage)
and is never transmitted to our servers. This content is NOT available to LLMs.

## Crawling Guidelines
- Static marketing pages: permitted
- /builder and /api routes: no user data is server-rendered; crawling these provides
  no meaningful content
- User data: not applicable (client-side only)

## Contact
Site: https://resume.devbench.co.in
